name: 电镜与能谱拼版 (TEM/HAADF/EDS & SEM Montage)
when: Grid montage of microscopy/elemental-mapping raster images (TEM, HAADF-STEM, EDS Si/Al/Cu maps, SEM) with tight pixel gaps, single clean panel letters (A/B/C/D), optional element badges, and scale bar preservation.

required_slots.images: Ordered list/grid of raw TIFF/PNG file paths mapped to (row, col) cells.

optional_slots.row_labels: Row panel letters (e.g. A, B, C for Fig3 3x5 TEM/EDS; A, B, C, D for FigS5 2x2 SEM).
optional_slots.badges: Per-cell element/modality badges (e.g. HAADF, Si, Al, Cu) when not burned in or when crisp vector overlay is required.
optional_slots.scale_bars: Physical scale bars (50 nm, 100 nm, 1 um) verified against mapping.csv / *.txt acquisition metadata.
optional_slots.crop: Optional aspect/square crop specification if source image aspect differs from tile aspect.

constraints: NEVER draw double panel letters (check whether raw TIFF already has burned-in A/B/C or scale bars before adding vector overlays!).
For Fig3 (3x5): use 1800x1800 *BF-TEM_1800px.tif + 512x512 HAADF/Si/Al/Cu.tif from data/raw_tem/ (NOT the 4096x4096 raw files unless downsampled cleanly), preserving tight ~2-4px gaps.
For FigS5 (2x2 SEM): use 1280x960 Fig.S5-A..D.tif from data/raw_sem/ matching PDF aspect 7.09 x 4.94 in.

notes: Fig3 (3x5): 7.09 x 4.24 in (510.2 x 305.3 pt). Rows = Catalyst-A (A), Catalyst-B (B), Catalyst-C (C); Cols = BF-TEM, HAADF, Si, Al, Cu.
FigS5 (2x2): 7.09 x 4.94 in (510.2 x 355.3 pt). Panels = Support (A), Catalyst-A (B), Catalyst-B (C), Catalyst-C (D).
Always cross-check raw TIFF images via read_file before deciding whether scale bars / EDS badges are burned into the bitmap or need vector overlays.
